label: Structured shared-IO hybrid - preceding 1s production59 state - next 1s primitive-consistent 17-coordinate output rederived to 59 - dedicated 32-knot return density on expected W256 embedding - 50% standardized derived-feature MSE + 50% return NLL - K1 1 - K2 1 - W256 M128 P128 F128 PF256 NF256 - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - no regularization - EMA 4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared GNGLU module; K1=K2=1 activates layers 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 and the two initial-state GNGLUs once
architecture.initialState: the immediately preceding completed production59 W embedding seeds M and P; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 maps NF to the expected W embedding; layer 2 decodes W to 17 primitive causal coordinates, and differentiable fixed code reconstructs all 59 next-state features
architecture.returnDensityState: a dedicated GNGLU reads the same expected W embedding and emits 32 fixed-knot log-density heights for the next completed 1s signed log return
architecture.baseConsistency: all derived production59 channels are reconstructed causally from the predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the input second

loss.description: 50% mean standardized MSE over the causally rederived next 59-feature state plus 50% proper continuous fixed-knot next-return NLL

density.target: next completed 1s BTC signed log return at production59 channel 0
density.expectation: mixture mass dotted with exact triangular-basis component return means

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s return expectation from the dedicated density head
evaluation.featureMetrics: the primitive decoder is separately evaluated on its complete causally reconstructed 59-feature state
evaluation.comparison: validation next-1s MSE skill, correlation, direction accuracy, and NLL are directly comparable with earlier one-step return-density runs

alignment.input: exactly the complete production59 timeline row at the clean example origin
alignment.target: the complete chronological production59 row at origin+1
alignment.causalDerivation: no target-derived feature enters either branch; only the predicted 17 primitive coordinates and history ending at the input origin reconstruct the next state
